description: Returns the account's published posts ranked against the median of the same social account on the same network over the last 90 days: for each post its network, brand, link, excerpt, metric (views where the network reports them, otherwise likes + reposts + replies), value, that median, how many posts the median covers (n), and what the post had (format, first-line type, day and time, length, hashtags). Posts younger than 24 hours are not ranked. Networks or posts whose numbers cannot be read are listed with the reason. Depending on the account's plan it also returns patterns across all posts (which format, day, time, length, hashtag use and first-line type did better); patterns need at least 10 measured posts. On a plan without patterns, locked.patterns_preview and locked.best_time say which patterns are ready and how large each effect is, without the winning value. Read-only.

brand_id.description: Only this brand's posts. Omit for all brands.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the day and time patterns, e.g. "America/Lima". Default UTC.

name: get_post_performance
